headline: Age of Empires II cheat codes
title: Age of Empires II Cheats | Cobra Car, Aegis, Marco | Classic Games
video_script: Age of Empires Two, from Ensemble Studios, came out in nineteen ninety nine, and its cheats are legendary. Press Enter and type how do you turn this on, to spawn a Shelby Cobra car. Type aegis for instant building, researching and training. Type marco to reveal the whole map, and robin hood to get gold. Which cheat did you use? Comment below!

scenes.fact: how do you turn this on

description: Age of Empires II (1999) classic cheats: how do you turn this on (Cobra car), aegis (instant build), marco (reveal map), robin hood (gold). Press Enter to type them.
